hero.title: An AI workspace that gets out of your way
hero.subtitle: Fast, streaming conversations in seven languages, with your documents and images alongside — and no lock-in to a single AI provider underneath.

features.title: Built for real work

chat.title: Answers as they're written
chat.body: Responses stream in from the first token, so you're reading while the model is still thinking.

files.title: Understands your files
files.body: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, CSV and plain text, extracted server-side and handed to the model as data — never as instructions.

vision.title: Sees your images
vision.body: Attach a screenshot or a photo and ask about what's in it.

global.title: Seven languages, properly
global.body: English, French, Arabic, Portuguese, Spanish, Japanese and Chinese — with real right-to-left layout, not a mirrored afterthought.

images.title: Generates images
images.body: Describe what you want and get an image back, kept in the conversation it came from.

privacy.title: Your conversations stay yours
privacy.body: Row-level security means one account cannot read another's history, and administrators do not get a window into your chats.

features.subtitle: Everything below works on the free plan. Nothing here is a demo.

closing.title: Start a conversation
closing.body: No card required. The free plan is a real product, not a trial.
